bio: Escape the every day to this charming estate in Surrey for the ultimate, quintessential dining experience. Nutfield Priory Hotel & Spa is nestled within picturesque gardens, where the hotel's striking architecture and impressive interiors create the perfect backdrop to indulge in an Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Cloisters Restaurant, or in The Library. In warmer months, there is also the option of enjoying Afternoon Tea alfresco. The elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this great British tradition.  The Afternoon Tea menu features an array of savoury treats, scones and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions throughout the year.  Nutfield Priory Hotel are also able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan and have special children's Afternoon Tea options. Why not upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury?  Please note Afternoon Tea is priced from £35pp Monday - Thursday, and £38pp Friday - Sunday.
